title: Fix auth token rotation for SSO users
description: SSO users are experiencing auth failures after token rotation. The refresh token flow doesn't account for the SAML assertion expiry, causing a 401 loop. Need to update the token refresh logic to re-initiate SAML flow when the assertion is expired.

subtasks.title: Reproduce the issue with test SSO provider
Update token refresh logic for SAML assertions
Add integration tests for SSO token rotation
Deploy fix to staging and verify

title: Implement L2 Redis cache for Aurora API
description: As outlined in the caching RFC, implement the distributed Redis cache layer (L2) for Aurora API read endpoints. This includes setting up the Redis cluster connection, implementing write-through invalidation, and adding cache hit/miss metrics to Datadog.

subtasks.title: Add Datadog metrics (hit rate, latency, evictions)
Load test with cache enabled vs disabled
